title: Barren Xaahih aqayyaare
intro: Ayyunti, dudda kee kaxxiina, sinni naggaarinni kaxxam qaleelal weeloysen. Takkay immay qado asta keenih rubte wak, imaan kee qanxaffeh aqayyaare, ken kaxxiina madaara sinni gitat ken beyte. Atu ta butta kee ken sadih xaloot baxissam duuddaa?
clues: Nanu xaahi masters sugneeh, qaxmeqe sigmoomi saanih qaleeli tattab fanah ceelak sugne.
ni ummattak farmoyti nee fan yemeete, inki numma le rabbih nee yaabissuh nee seecak.
Nanu kay qangor cednuh asta esserneeh, baxsale gino aqayyaareh neh baahe.
Nanu sahlin amri yomcowwe: ni leeh raceena ta gino lih tabaatabisnuh, tet faatacisen ayro taaqubeemih cabnay.
ni kaxxiinih addat, nek dago mari celsis kee nanu maabitina sadneh, ni asta takkem faxxiimak sugte gino qidneh.
Nanu sidiica ayro nek qimbbisen, tokkeek kaxxa bakaq ni buxaaxil nee yibbixeeh, mano sinnim nee cabeeh, nek rade.

location.label: Ni aydaaduk fanti dagari macak sugteeh?

arabic: فَعَقَرُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰصَـٰلِحُ ٱئْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers." (7:77)
